# Calidigi — California Digital Growth & AI Company

> Calidigi is a California-based digital growth company helping businesses attract customers, generate leads, and grow through web development, digital marketing, local SEO, branding, and AI-powered solutions.

## About

Calidigi is a full-service digital agency headquartered in San Francisco, California. We work with businesses across 30+ industries to build stronger digital presences, automate operations with AI, and create measurable growth opportunities. We have delivered 500+ projects with a 98% client retention rate and generated $50M+ in client revenue.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://www.calidigi.com/services/web-development) — High-converting websites, landing pages, e-commerce, CMS development, and performance optimization
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.calidigi.com/services/digital-marketing) — SEO, content marketing, social media marketing, paid campaigns, lead generation, and analytics
- [Local SEO](https://www.calidigi.com/services/local-seo) — Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword strategy, citation building, and reputation management
- [Branding & Creative](https://www.calidigi.com/services/branding) — Brand strategy, logo design, visual identity systems, and marketing materials
- [AI Solutions](https://www.calidigi.com/services/ai-automation) — AI integration, business automation, intelligent workflows, and predictive analytics
- [Business Growth](https://www.calidigi.com/services/business-growth) — Lead generation, conversion optimization, and growth strategy
